review_candidates.title: Software Quality Control Engineer
review_candidates.description: About CTX CTX builds the CTX Corporate Booking Platform, an enterprise travel management platform used by large organisations and government entities across the region. It covers the full corporate travel lifecycle: travel requests, policy and approval workflows, flight and hotel booking, payments and post-trip reconciliation. The platform is deeply integrated with clients' HR and ERP systems, so reliability and data accuracy matter in every release. About the Role We are looking for a Quality Control Engineer to make sure every release of our platform works as our clients expect. You will test web applications, APIs and enterprise integrations end to end, catch issues before they reach production, and help us move more of our regression testing into automation. Department: Engineering (Quality Assurance) · Level: Mid-level · Experience: 3+ years · Full-time, fully remote · Monday–Friday Key Responsibilities Functional & Release Testing Design and execute test cases from requirements and acceptance criteria. Perform functional, integration, regression, smoke and end-to-end testing across the platform. Test business-critical travel flows such as travel policy rules, multi-level approvals, flight and hotel booking, cancellations and changes. Run exploratory testing to find edge cases, for example unusual itineraries, policy exceptions or role-based access. Execute release validation and post-deployment checks across development, staging and production. Support client User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing test data, reproducing reported issues and verifying fixes. API, Data & Integration Testing Test RESTful APIs with Postman or similar tools, covering payloads, authentication, error handling and business logic. Validate data with SQL queries in PostgreSQL or MySQL to confirm consistency and correctness. Test integrations with client systems such as Oracle Fusion and Oracle Integration Cloud, for example employee data sync and trip or expense records. Identify integration failures and data mismatches, and work with backend engineers to reproduce and resolve them. Defect Management & Improvement Log, track and verify defects in Jira with clear steps, evidence and impact. Maintain test plans, test cases and regression suites. Contribute to automated UI and API tests and help integrate them into CI/CD pipelines. Apply risk-based testing to focus effort on the most critical client workflows. Report testing progress and release risks clearly to support go/no-go decisions. Required Qualifications 3+ years of experience in software QA, quality control or testing. Strong manual testing experience on web applications and backend systems. Solid knowledge of testing methodologies, test levels and the STLC. Hands-on API testing with Postman or similar tools. Good understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, JSON and authentication. Working SQL knowledge for validating data in PostgreSQL or MySQL. Experience logging and tracking defects in Jira or a similar tool. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and the SDLC. Ability to turn business requirements into effective test scenarios. Strong attention to detail and clear written and spoken English communication. Nice to Have Test automation with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium. API test automation with Postman/Newman or similar. Scripting in JavaScript, Python or PHP. Experience testing travel booking systems, ERP integrations (Oracle Fusion) or enterprise SaaS. Experience supporting client UAT cycles. Performance testing with JMeter or k6. Basic knowledge of security testing and common web vulnerabilities. ISTQB certification or equivalent. What We're Looking For Someone who treats quality as their own responsibility and thinks beyond the written test case. You enjoy investigating unexpected behaviour, write defect reports developers can act on immediately, and keep an independent view while working closely with the team. You balance thorough testing with realistic delivery timelines. Why Join CTX Test a platform that large enterprises and government entities rely on for corporate travel. Build deep experience in API, data and enterprise integration testing. Help shape our QA process and grow into test automation. Work remotely within a structured, collaborative engineering team.

Job Description The IT Application Support Analyst role is responsible for the end-to-end investigation and resolution of ERP incidents requiring deeper functional or technical expertise, including root-cause analysis, integration troubleshooting, solution validation, documentation, and effective escalation to Level 3 when required. Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability Incident investigation and resolution Analyze ERP incidents escalated from Level 1. Identify root causes and provide functional or technical solutions/workarounds. Reproduce issues and distinguish between configuration, master data, integration, application, and infrastructure problems. Functional support Provide expertise across assigned ERP modules and business processes. Troubleshoot transactional errors and incorrect system behavior. Assist users with complex process or application-related questions. Integration troubleshooting Investigate failures between the ERP and connected applications. Analyze interfaces, error messages, batch jobs, queues, and data flows. Coordinate resolution with other application/support teams when the problem crosses system boundaries. Escalation to Level 3 Determine when an issue requires development, product expertise, infrastructure changes, or vendor intervention. Provide Level 3 with a complete analysis, including reproduction steps, logs, examples, expected versus actual results, and business impact. Validate the solution after Level 3 implementation. Problem management and root-cause analysis Identify recurring incidents and underlying systemic problems. Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis. Recommend permanent corrective and preventive actions. Change and release support Assess the impact of fixes, configuration changes, and ERP updates. Perform functional/system testing and coordinate business validation when appropriate. Support deployments and post-deployment verification. Monitoring and operational support Monitor critical ERP processes, scheduled jobs, integrations, and interfaces. Investigate failures proactively where monitoring is available. Ensure critical business processes are restored within agreed service levels. Ticket and SLA management Own assigned incidents through resolution rather than simply forwarding them. Prioritize according to severity and business impact. Maintain clear, accurate ticket documentation and regular communication with users. Knowledge management Document solutions, known errors, troubleshooting procedures, and recurring issues. Create knowledge articles that enable Level 1 to resolve more incidents independently. Share knowledge with other ERP support team members. Business and IT coordination Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams. Translate business symptoms into technical/functional requirements for specialists. Communicate technical findings in language understandable to business stakeholders. CRITICAL CAPABILITIES Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ERP Functional Expertise Strong understanding of core ERP processes and assigned functional areas (BaanIV, Infor LN, or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012). Ability to understand how transactions flow across modules. Ability to distinguish process, configuration, master-data, and system issues. Advanced Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis Systematic investigation of complex incidents. Identify symptom vs. root cause. Analyze application errors, logs, jobs, interfaces, and transaction history. Develop and validate workarounds when immediate resolution is unavailable. Integration & End-to-End Process Understanding Understand ERP interfaces with upstream and downstream applications. Trace transactions across systems. Determine where a failure occurred and which team/application owns it. Understand dependencies between ERP, middleware, databases, reporting, and external systems. Incident Ownership & Prioritization Take ownership from escalation through resolution. Assess business impact, urgency, and priority. Drive resolution across multiple technical or functional teams. Maintain clear communication with impacted users and stakeholders. Technical Analysis Ability to investigate application logs, batch processes, queues, interfaces, and error messages. Basic understanding of databases and data structures. Ability to perform data analysis and queries where appropriate. Understand enough of the ERP technical architecture to engage effectively with developers and infrastructure teams. Requirements EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related) EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of experience as an ERP application support or ERP analyst preferred. 3+ years of process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset. 2+ years of experience working with BaanIV, Infor LN or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012. review_candidates.description: Role Summary The Helpdesk Executive is the first point of contact for customers with audio-visual (AV) product issues and service requests. The role logs and triages calls, assigns the right field engineer or vendor, dispatches spares, coordinates installations, and keeps accurate documentation. The goal is fast resolution, clear communication, and a dependable network of onsite support partners. Key Responsibilities 1. Call handling and ticket management Receive customer calls, emails and portal requests, and log each one as a ticket in the helpdesk or CRM system. Do first-level troubleshooting by phone or remote session, and resolve simple issues without a site visit. Prioritise tickets by severity and SLA, and follow up until closure. Keep customers updated on status, ETA and resolution. 2. Field engineer alignment Assign onsite calls to in-house field engineers based on location, skill set and availability. Share complete job details with the engineer (site address, contact person, issue history, product model and serial number). Track engineer check-in and check-out, visit outcomes and pending actions. Escalate delayed or repeat calls to the Service Manager. 3. Vendor identification and management Search for, shortlist and onboard qualified service vendors and channel partners for onsite technical support in locations without in-house coverage. Check vendor credentials: AV/IT technical competence, certifications, past work, manpower, response time and coverage area. Collect and compare quotes, rate cards and SLA commitments, and maintain an approved vendor database by city and region. Allocate onsite calls to vendors, monitor their performance (response time, first-time fix rate, customer feedback) and raise issues with them. Coordinate vendor invoicing, service reports and payment follow-up with the accounts team. 4. Spares dispatch and logistics Identify the spare parts needed from the engineer’s or customer’s diagnosis. Raise spare requests, coordinate with the warehouse or stores, and arrange dispatch through couriers or logistics partners. Track shipments to delivery, confirm receipt, and follow up on faulty part returns (RMA). Maintain records of spares issued, returned and pending. 5. Installation coordination and support Schedule installations and commissioning with customers, sales teams and engineers or vendors. Confirm site readiness (power, network, cabling, mounting, access permissions) before the visit. Send installation checklists, product documentation and configuration details to the assigned engineer. Collect installation reports and customer sign-offs, and follow up on any snag list. 6. Documentation and reporting Maintain service records, call logs, engineer and vendor reports, warranty and AMC details, and RMA records. Prepare and update product documents for AV products (user manuals, installation guides, troubleshooting guides, FAQs, quick-start sheets, service SOPs). Build a knowledge base of recurring issues and fixes. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports covering call volume, TAT, SLA compliance, pending calls, spares status and vendor performance. Required Qualifications Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, IT, Electrical, Communication or a related field. 1–3 years of experience in a helpdesk, technical support or service coordination role, ideally with AV, IT or electronics products. Skills and Competencies Working knowledge of AV products and systems (displays, projectors, video conferencing, audio and DSP, control systems, cabling and signal flow, networking basics). Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability. Experience with ticketing or CRM tools, MS Excel and email. Vendor sourcing, negotiation and coordination skills. Clear written and spoken English and Hindi; regional languages are a plus. Good technical documentation skills. Ability to manage multiple calls under pressure, with attention to detail and ownership.

review_candidates.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Systems Engineering, C/C++)
review_candidates.description: Job Summary NetApp is seeking a highly experienced Senior Software Development Engineer to help lead innovation across cloud infrastructure, software-defined storage, virtualization, and distributed systems technologies. This role is responsible for driving the design and execution of foundational infrastructure capabilities that power NetApp’s cloud-native storage and data management services across hyperscaler cloud environments. As an Senior Software Engineer, you will apply broad and deep expertise across multiple specialized disciplines including distributed systems, Linux systems software, storage architecture, networking infrastructure, and virtualization technologies. You will contribute to significant technical initiatives spanning multiple products, teams, and partner organizations while influencing architecture, execution, scalability, and operational excellence across the organization. This role requires strong technical leadership, advanced systems thinking, and the ability to identify challenges and blockers early while navigating complex technical and organizational constraints to deliver impactful outcomes. Responsibilities Lead the design and development of scalable, resilient, and high-performance infrastructure components across storage, networking, virtualization, and Linux systems layers. Drive architecture and technical direction for major subsystems within software-defined storage, virtualization infrastructure, and distributed cloud platforms. Contribute to significant portions of the product across multiple technical domains and projects while coordinating execution across stakeholders and partner teams. Architect and optimize storage and networking data paths for performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency in cloud-scale environments. Provide technical leadership across virtualization technologies including KVM/QEMU, hypervisor integrations, virtual networking, storage virtualization, and infrastructure orchestration. Drive engineering excellence through strong design practices, observability, scalability, reliability, automation, and operational readiness. Lead resolution of highly complex technical challenges involving distributed systems, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise storage technologies. Influence technical direction across organizations through architecture reviews, technical mentoring, design leadership, and cross-functional collaboration. Establish effective technical collaboration models across engineering teams and partner organizations to drive alignment and execution. Mentor engineers and help scale organizational engineering capability through technical guidance and leadership. Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, storage, and virtualization platforms. Job Requirements 12+ years of experience in systems software engineering, distributed infrastructure platforms, virtualization, storage systems, or cloud infrastructure development. Expert-level programming skills in C/C++ with strong proficiency in Python. Deep expertise in Linux operating systems internals, kernel technologies, systems architecture, concurrency, memory management, and performance engineering. Significant experience designing and building distributed storage systems, software-defined infrastructure platforms, or cloud-native infrastructure services. Deep expertise with virtualization stacks including KVM/QEMU, virtio, hypervisors, virtual storage, and virtual networking technologies. Strong experience with storage and networking subsystems, kernel development, or device driver development. Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture, scalability, fault tolerance, reliability engineering, and operational excellence. Strong operational expertise with hyperscaler cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI. Proven ability to lead large cross-functional technical initiatives and influence engineering outcomes across organizations. Exceptional debugging, systems analysis, and performance optimization capabilities. Strong communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to independently solve highly complex technical challenges with broad organizational impact. Preferred Qualifications Experience architecting enterprise-scale storage operating systems such as ONTAP or similar platforms. Experience driving large-scale infrastructure modernization or platform transformation initiatives. Contributions to open-source systems software, kernel, virtualization, storage, or cloud infrastructure ecosystems. Recognized technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, virtualization, or storage platforms. Advanced cloud certifications or equivalent industry-recognized expertise. Education Bachelors or Masters Degree in computer scicnece or similar field is preferred. Compensation The target salary range for this position is 196,350 - 292,600 USD. The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off, various Leave options, Performance-Based Incentives, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s), with all offerings subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. Benefits may vary by country and region, and further details will be provided as part of the recruitment process. At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process. Equal Opportunity Employer NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification. Why You'll Thrive at NetApp At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure. NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security. Our culture We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do. If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now. Submitting an Application To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application. AI Disclosure For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

review_candidates.title: Procurement Intern
review_candidates.description: 📝 Procurement Intern (Unpaid) ⚠️ Applications will only be accepted through the following site: 👉 www.owlera.site About Owlera Owlera is an AI-powered career platform that helps students and fresh graduates gain practical experience through internship simulations inspired by real companies. Participants work on realistic business challenges, receive AI-powered feedback, use modern professional tools, and build portfolio-ready projects that demonstrate their abilities to future employers. We're looking for analytical, detail-driven students to join our Procurement Internship and gain hands-on experience in how companies source, evaluate, and manage the suppliers that keep a business running — from spend analysis and vendor negotiations to purchase orders and supplier scorecards. About the Internship As a Procurement Intern, you'll work on realistic procurement challenges involving spend analysis, supplier evaluation, RFQ processes, contract comparisons, and cost-savings tracking. You'll learn how procurement teams balance cost, quality, and risk to make sure the right goods and services arrive at the right time, at the right price. Responsibilities * Analyze mock spend data to identify cost patterns, categories, and savings opportunities. * Build spend dashboards breaking down purchases by category, vendor, and department. * Draft mock RFQs (requests for quotation) with clear specifications and timelines. * Compare vendor quotes in mock datasets and recommend the best-fit supplier. * Build supplier scorecards rating mock vendors on price, quality, delivery, and reliability. * Research supplier qualification criteria and draft evaluation checklists. * Draft mock purchase order summaries with terms, quantities, and delivery schedules. * Review mock contract excerpts and summarize key commercial terms. * Analyze lead-time data for mock suppliers and flag delay risks. * Track cost-savings initiatives and build savings-vs-target reports. * Research total cost of ownership (TCO) and compare it with unit-price-only views. * Draft negotiation prep briefs with objectives, walk-away points, and leverage analysis. * Analyze single-source vs. multi-source supplier strategies for mock categories. * Map a mock procure-to-pay process and identify bottlenecks and control gaps. * Draft supplier onboarding checklists covering compliance and documentation. * Research ethical sourcing and sustainability criteria for mock vendor policies. * Build approval-workflow outlines for purchase requests at different spend levels. * Analyze inventory reorder patterns and draft reorder-point recommendations. * Summarize procurement KPIs (cost savings, on-time delivery, PO cycle time) in mock reports. * Use AI tools for data analysis, reporting, documentation, and research. * Present procurement analyses and sourcing recommendations to stakeholders. Requirements * Current student or recent graduate in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, Operations, or a related field. * Strong interest in how companies source goods and services strategically. * Analytical, detail-oriented thinker comfortable with numbers. * Comfortable working with spreadsheets and basic data analysis. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Organized, structured, and reliable with documentation. * Interest in negotiation, supplier management, or business operations. * Familiarity with Excel/Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables) is a plus but not required. * Familiarity with ERP or procurement software concepts (SAP, Oracle) is a plus but not required. * Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms is a plus. * Previous professional procurement experience is not required. What You'll Gain * Hands-on experience solving realistic procurement and sourcing challenges. * Practical experience with spend analysis and savings tracking. * Experience building supplier scorecards and evaluation frameworks. * Experience drafting RFQs and comparing vendor proposals. * Understanding of total cost of ownership and negotiation preparation. * Experience mapping procure-to-pay processes and approval workflows. * Practical exposure to inventory planning and lead-time analysis. * Understanding of procurement KPIs and supplier performance reporting. * Experience using AI and modern procurement tools. * Portfolio-ready procurement projects. * Personalized AI feedback on your work. * Professional certificate upon successful completion. * Mentorship and weekly learning sessions. * Opportunity to strengthen your portfolio, resume, and interview readiness. Internship Details Role: Procurement Intern Location: Remote Type: Internship (Unpaid) Level: Entry Level Duration: 6 Weeks Commitment: Flexible (approximately 10–15 hours per week) If you're curious about the deals, data, and decisions behind every product a company buys — we'd love to hear from you. ⚠️ Apply through: 👉 www.owlera.site

review_candidates.title: Technical Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description City Floor Decoration is the exclusive reseller of Forbo Flooring products in Egypt, offering a wide range of high-end solutions for commercial environments. Partnering with a global leader with more than 150 years of experience, the company delivers durable, design-oriented, and environmentally conscious floor coverings. Forbo Flooring solutions are integrated into everyday life, shaping the surfaces people walk on at home, at work, and in public spaces, and supporting the movement of people and goods. City Floor Decoration focuses on providing reliable, high-quality products and services that enhance the user experience and meet demanding commercial standards. Role Description The Technical Sales Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in New Cairo. This role is responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities for Forbo flooring solutions, managing customer accounts, and achieving sales targets in commercial segments. Day-to-day tasks include conducting site visits, preparing technical proposals and quotations, delivering product presentations and demonstrations, and providing technical guidance on product selection, installation requirements, and maintenance. The Technical Sales Engineer will collaborate with project owners, consultants, contractors, and internal teams to ensure projects are specified correctly and executed smoothly. The role also involves handling technical inquiries, troubleshooting product-related issues, and maintaining detailed records of opportunities, pipelines, and customer interactions. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Technical Sales and Sales skills, with a proven ability to manage the full sales cycle and meet or exceed targets. Candidates should possess Sales Engineering skills, including the ability to translate technical product features into clear value propositions for customers and stakeholders. Candidates should possess Technical Support skills to address customer inquiries, provide installation and application guidance, and assist with problem resolution. Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear presentation abilities, negotiation capability, and effective relationship-building with diverse customer groups. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Architecture, Mechanical, or related field) or a closely related technical discipline is preferred. Experience in flooring, building materials, construction, or interior finishes is highly beneficial. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple projects and work independently on-site. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with CRM tools is an advantage. Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to client sites and project locations as needed.
